In a video call, tap “Share screen” and open this app — everyone will see your selected photo or video.

Android does not allow replacing the system camera without root.

1. Pick a photo or video.
2. Tap “Go fullscreen”.
3. In Telegram, WhatsApp, Zoom, Google Meet or Discord start a call and choose “Share screen”.
4. Open Fake Camera — the other side sees exactly this screen.

Tip: tap “Overlay window” — Fake Camera will minimize and the demo will stay on top of other apps. Drag the handle to move it, use the corner to resize, or expand it to full screen.

If “Overlay window” is unavailable, use “PiP window” — it works without the display-over-other-apps permission.
